Lake citations verify official cite 799 F.3d 1361, vendor-neutral cite 2015 WL 5157456, and no parallel citation.
The opinion states that approaching Walker's vehicle in the open-sided carport instead of the front door did not exceed the geographic limit on the knock-and-talk exception.

The opinion states that a small departure from the front door when seeking to contact occupants is permissible, and that officers entered the carport because they had reason to believe the occupant was sitting in the car.
The opinion states that the 5:04 a.m. approach was reasonable under the circumstances and the footnote rejects an exigency requirement for a warrantless early-morning knock and talk.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the circumstance-specific qualifier; the timing point should not be stated as a blanket rule for all pre-dawn approaches.
